🎥🎬: Landman (2024–Present)

Set in the oil fields of West Texas, Landman follows Tommy Norris, a crisis manager working for an oil company. His job puts him at the centre of a high-stakes industry where enormous amounts of money, dangerous accidents, powerful corporations, and personal rivalries collide.

While Tommy tries to keep drilling operations running and solve problems before they become disasters, his complicated family life creates another set of challenges. As the oil business grows more dangerous and competitive, Tommy finds himself caught between corporate interests, wealthy investors, workers, and people willing to do almost anything for power.

The series explores the brutal realities of the modern oil industry while following Tommy’s struggle to protect his family and maintain control in a world where one mistake can cost everything.

#Landman #BillyBobThornton #OilIndustry #TaylorSheridan #DramaSeries
